issue_context.title: No memory metrics from kubelet stats endpoint
issue_context.body:
#### What happened:
Since upgrading from Kubernetes `1.19.8` to `1.20.8` we no longer get memory metrics from the `/stats/summary` endpoint on `kubelet`.

Example:
```json
"memory": {
    "time": "2021-06-30T15:12:35Z",
    "availableBytes": 1073741824,
    "usageBytes": 0,
    "workingSetBytes": 0,
    "rssBytes": 0,
    "pageFaults": 0,
    "majorPageFaults": 0
}
```

#### What you expected to happen:
In our previous version, `1.19.8` we would get a response like the following that included utilisation metrics:

```json
"memory": {
    "time": "2021-06-30T14:18:35Z",
    "usageBytes": 45252608,
    "workingSetBytes": 35295232,
    "rssBytes": 32563200,
    "pageFaults": 1722682401,
    "majorPageFaults": 0
}
```

#### How to reproduce it (as minimally and precisely as possible):
Hit the `/stats/summary` endpoint of `kubelet` on a cluster running version `1.20.8`.

#### Environment:
- Kubernetes version (use `kubectl version`): `Server Version: version.Info{Major:"1", Minor:"20", GitVersion:"v1.20.8", GitCommit:"5575935422cc1cf5169dfc8847cb587aa47bac5a", GitTreeState:"clean", BuildDate:"2021-06-16T12:53:07Z", GoVersion:"go1.15.13", Compiler:"gc", Platform:"linux/amd64"}`
- Cloud provider or hardware configuration: Provisioned on AWS with `kops`
- OS (e.g: `cat /etc/os-release`): Flatcar Container Linux by Kinvolk 2765.2.6 (Oklo)
- Kernel (e.g. `uname -a`): 5.10.43-flatcar

I was able to repro finally -- it looks like missing key here is that you must be using the **systemd cgroup driver**. With this patch 

```
$ git diff
diff --git a/cluster/gce/gci/configure-helper.sh b/cluster/gce/gci/configure-helper.sh
index 432939814b9..479928017c4 100644
--- a/cluster/gce/gci/configure-helper.sh
+++ b/cluster/gce/gci/configure-helper.sh
@@ -3025,6 +3025,8 @@ oom_score = -999
   default_runtime_name = "runc"
 [plugins."io.containerd.grpc.v1.cri".containerd.runtimes.runc]
   runtime_type = "io.containerd.runc.v2"
+  [plugins."io.containerd.grpc.v1.cri".containerd.runtimes.runc.options]
+    SystemdCgroup = true
 [plugins."io.containerd.grpc.v1.cri".registry.mirrors."docker.io"]
   endpoint = ["https://mirror.gcr.io","https://registry-1.docker.io"]
 EOF
diff --git a/cluster/gce/util.sh b/cluster/gce/util.sh
index ff4084b7f59..dafbe19e49d 100755
--- a/cluster/gce/util.sh
+++ b/cluster/gce/util.sh
@@ -835,6 +835,8 @@ function construct-linux-kubelet-flags {
     flags+=" --container-runtime-endpoint=${CONTAINER_RUNTIME_ENDPOINT}"
   fi

+  flags+=" --cgroup-driver=systemd"
+
   KUBELET_ARGS="${flags}"
 }
```

@bobbypage  With debugging, I found that on kubernetes 1.21.2 when using different cgroup driver, the cgroupPath format of containers are different.
1. kubelet: systemd + containerd:cgroupfs
```
"/kubepods.slice/kubepods-burstable.slice/kubepods-burstable-pod2fc932ce_fdcc_454b_97bd_aadfdeb4c340.slice/cri-containerd-aaefb9d8feed2d453b543f6d928cede7a4dbefa6a0ae7c9b990dd234c56e93b9.scope"
```
2. kubelet: systemd + containerd: systemd
```
"/kubepods-burstable-pod2fc932ce_fdcc_454b_97bd_aadfdeb4c340.slice:cri-containerd:db622e6f7b16079db56fd7814031f7e8fc78b3050c24fe2fc431beeebbeb1c8e"
```
3. kubelet: cgroupfs + containerd: cgroupfs
```
/kubepods/burstable/pod2fc932ce-fdcc-454b-97bd-aadfdeb4c340/9be25294016e2dc0340dd605ce1f57b492039b267a6a618a7ad2a7a58a740f32
```

The `caInfos := getCRICadvisorStats(allInfos)` would return a map using the path.Base of cgroupPath https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/dadecb2c8932fd28de9dfb94edbc7bdac7d0d28f/pkg/kubelet/stats/cri_stats_provider.go#L164 

Later, we use containerID `caStats, caFound := caInfos[containerID]` to check to add metrics. https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/dadecb2c8932fd28de9dfb94edbc7bdac7d0d28f/pkg/kubelet/stats/cri_stats_provider.go#L202

So only in the third case, the  key of `caInfos` are `containerID`. That's how the cgroup driver impacts the metrics.

To sum up, `custom containerd socket path` and `cgroup drivers` are two different cases that caused this issue. 
For the `cgroup driver` case, I think it's a bug we need fix: we should make sure the key of `caInfos` always be `containerID`

BTW @bobbypage  do you know why the cgroupPath format are different when using different cgroup driver?

> BTW @bobbypage do you know why the cgroupPath format are different when using different cgroup driver?

I believe it's expected that the cgroup naming will differ when using systemd cgroup driver vs cgroupfs. Kubelet internally has some logic for parsing and converting between the two different formats, e.g.

https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/5be21c5/pkg/kubelet/cm/cgroup_manager_linux.go#L132-L134
and 
https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/blob/5be21c5/pkg/kubelet/cm/cgroup_manager_linux.go#L109-L118
